نحتوي (form VIII)
# نَحْتَوِي (naḥtawī) /naħ.ta.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
# نَحْتَوِيَ (naḥtawiya) /naħ.ta.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
